newsitem.title: HONG KONG: S&P assigns BB rating to Road King.
newsitem.headline: S&P assigns BB rating to Road King.

text.p: Standard & Poor's said on Friday it had assigned its BB corporate credit rating to Road King Infrastructure Ltd.

The rating agency said it also assigned its BB corporate credit rating and long-term rating to the US$100 million notes due 2007 issued by Road King subsidiary Road King Infrastrucutre Finance Ltd (1997).
Hong Kong-based Road King has total assets of more than US$400 million and holds interests in 22 highway projects in China, S&P said.
The rating outlook is stable, it said.
Bond proceeds will be used for general corporate purposes, in particular to fund future investment opportunities that arise, it added.
S&P said the rating reflects the strong macroeconomic fundamentals of the Chinese transport sector and the great capacity constraints of the existing road network.

It also reflects Road King's geographically diversified investment portfolio, favourable profit distribution arrangements with local partners, strong financial profile, and experienced management team.

S&P also noted risks, including aggressive assumptions on high traffic volume and toll increases, considerable foreign exchange exposure, the ambiguous legality of guaranteed returns, potential multi-modal competition and increased political risks, and weak financing covenants.
